notes: 1/9 runs 5/5 with simulator truth (5/45 trials); 7 runs stopped at the driver gate and y-s3140-r1 at the controller gate, all by the 40-call front limit and before any actuation. Zero unconfirmed actuations, no transient or rate-limit retries.
